questions.prompt: How many total individual wooden toothpicks are consumed across all commercial restaurants operating in Canada in a single year?
reasoning: Canada has approximately 100,000 restaurants serving meals daily
Each restaurant might use an average of 15 boxes of toothpicks per year, with 300 toothpicks per box
Multiplying 100,000 restaurants by 4,500 toothpicks yields roughly 450 million toothpicks consumed annually

questions.prompt: How many total individual pinecones are produced by all mature coniferous pine trees growing across the forested land area of Sweden in a single autumn season?
reasoning: Sweden has about 23 billion trees, roughly half of which are mature pine and spruce trees bearing cones
An average mature coniferous tree yields a few hundred pinecones in a typical mast year
Estimating an average of 1,000 cone-bearing trees per hectare across millions of forested hectares gives around 12 billion pinecones

questions.prompt: How many total individual plastic credit and debit cards are manufactured and issued by all financial institutions in Australia in a single year?
reasoning: Australia has a population of about 26 million people holding multiple banking products
Standard bank cards expire and are reissued every three to four years, requiring around 7 million replacements annually
Adding new accounts, secondary cards, and business cards brings the yearly total production to approximately 22 million cards
